description: Manual audit of 50 random insights produced by enrichment prompt v2, read and labelled by hand on 2026-11-25 with the same label definitions as insights_v1_baseline.json. Population: the 4,400 rows whose insight changed between site exports f34b17c (23 Nov) and 0ba1077 (24 Nov 17:30), i.e. rows re-enriched before that export; random.seed(11), random.sample(rows, 50).

labels.unsupported: states a specific fact (name, number, place, date, or the company's business, sector, history, strategy or finances) not in the headline or company name
labels.outside: leans on outside knowledge or speculation (market conditions, sector trends, precedents) without a checkable invented fact
labels.clean: reasons only from the headline, or explains what this announcement type generally means
